method: staggered-grid (Yee) real-symmetric matrix eigensolver, three grids N0, 2N0, 4N0 (N0 = 60: every node is a node of the Rust 301-point grid), extrapolation eliminating h^2 and h^3; Anderson-mixed SCF on (n_c, S_c); particle/sea branches by continuity from lambda = 0 (rank against the free spectrum)

conventions.parity: 0 = both Z2 sectors filled together (Rust convention); +1/-1 = one sector
conventions.tip: g0: g(-L) = 0, i.e. gamma^0 chi(-L) = +chi(-L) (the theta = 0 member of the chiral-bag family, the Rust crate's b(-L) = 0)
conventions.xc: quadratic: M_eff = m + (15/16) lambda S_p, v_x = -lambda n_p/16, e_x = -(lambda/32)(n_p^2 + S_p^2)
conventions.T0fallback: stagnant exact aufbau -> occupation smearing 1e-4 m, 1e-3 m (recorded)
conventions.heatCapacity: central difference (delta = 0.05 T) for T <= 0.3 m, fixed-spectrum C_V^(0) above; both fixed-spectrum forms always

blockReduction.closedForm: A0 = sigma_z, A4 = sigma_x, A1 = s i sigma_y (s = J), B = b 1 (b = J iK1), C = b sigma_y, B C = -i gamma^4 = sigma_y
blockReduction.ksOperator2x2: h_s = -i sigma_x d/dy + M_eff sigma_y - s k kappa sigma_z + v_x

geometry.israelConvention: S^i_j = -(1/kappa)([K^i_j] - delta^i_j [K]), [X] = X(0+) - X(0-), normal from y<0 to y>0, W = e^{-H|y|}
geometry.specNote: STAGE4_SPEC writes p_req = -15H^2/kappa; the mixed components give T^i_i = G^i_i/kappa = +15H^2/kappa (all seven transverse directions) and rho_req = -T^4_4 = -21H^2/kappa < 0.

couplingRule: per configuration (m, L, N), from the free ground state of that configuration (both parities): strength = max_y max((15/16)|S_p|, n_p/16)/m^7 with the maximum over the Rust crate's 301 grid nodes (the LDA pair (M_eff - m, v_x) per unit lambda_hat, in units of m); lambda_hat_1 = 0.1/strength, lambda_hat_2 = 1.0/strength (the rule of the Rust crate, runs.rs), evaluated independently here (`coupling_rust_grid`: the occupied free levels on 300, 600 and 1200 intervals, whose coarse nodes are the Rust nodes, three-level extrapolation); the convergence runs (a4_0 = 0.5, Delta k = 0.25 e^-0.5 m, Delta k = 0.125 m) use the values of (1, 3, N_mid); the achieved max|lambda S_p|/m is in every run.json (levels[].energies.maxLambdaSOverM)
skippedRuns: m1_L3_N112_lamp1_T1: not run (T/m = 1 with lambda != 0 and N > 8; ~5e5 levels per grid and iteration; the Rust crate skips it too)
m1_L3_N112_lamh_T1: not run (T/m = 1 with lambda != 0 and N > 8; ~5e5 levels per grid and iteration; the Rust crate skips it too)
